status: DESIGN ONLY — no live rule engine, no licensed validation
copy_intro: A few details can change which coverage fits. Let’s check what matters for you.

S01.title: Joining a plan
S01.section: Am I eligible?; Initial Enrollment Period; Other enrollment periods
S01.note: MA requires A+B; standalone drug plans require A or B. Service area and enrollment periods matter. These are distinct from an application or verified eligibility.

S02.title: Plan for Medicare
S02.section: Plan for Medicare; When to sign up
S02.note: Age-based and non-age Medicare eligibility exist. An age or a coverage preference alone is not an enrollment determination.

S03.title: When coverage starts
S03.section: Initial Enrollment Period; Signing up for premium-free Part A later; Special Enrollment Period
S03.note: Initial enrollment and start dates depend on circumstances. First-day birthdays and retroactive Part A are material. Do not treat requested coverage month as an effective date.

S04.title: Working past 65
S04.section: Health insurance from a job; COBRA; Before you sign up
S04.note: Current-employment group coverage can differ from retiree/individual coverage. Job and coverage end dates can differ. Employer confirmation matters; HSA contributions can be affected by Medicare start dates.

S05.title: Who pays first?
S05.section: Current/former group coverage; employer-size paths; Federal Program/TRICARE paths
S05.note: The age-65 coordination questions use 20 employees; the under-65 disability path uses 100. Multi-employer and ESRD circumstances need their own analysis. Do not apply one threshold to everyone.

S06.title: COBRA coverage
S06.section: How does COBRA work with Medicare?
S06.note: COBRA is continuation coverage and does not restart the Part B employment-based sign-up period. Possible gaps and payer coordination need review.

S07.title: Retiree insurance
S07.section: Drug coverage; check before making decisions
S07.note: Joining outside coverage can affect retiree/family benefits; obtain benefits-administrator confirmation. Do not infer creditable drug status merely from the word retiree.

S08.title: Creditable drug coverage
S08.section: Why do I need creditable coverage?; What you should do
S08.note: A creditable-coverage notice is relevant evidence. A gap of 63 days or more may create a Part D penalty; this is not the same clock as a Part B enrollment period.

S09.title: When can I buy Medigap?
S09.section: Federal-rights notice; Advantage trial/history questions; situation-specific answers
S09.note: Trial/guaranteed-issue possibilities depend on the exact event and history. First Medicare Advantage use and prior Medigap matter. Do not generalize one event-specific 63-day result to all cases.

S10.title: Medigap basics
S10.note: Federal Medigap open enrollment and later purchase are different. State rights may add protection. Medigap belongs with Original Medicare, not as a new Advantage supplement.

S11.title: Change Medigap policy
S11.section: Can I change my Medigap policy?
S11.note: Outside protected situations switching can be limited. Do not cancel existing coverage on a provisional match; replacement/free-look details need review.

S12.title: Florida Statutes 627.6741
S12.note: Florida provides described six-month opportunities for qualifying residents including certain under-65 disability/ESRD beneficiaries, and a two-month opportunity after qualifying group-policy termination. Application to a particular event and future year requires expert review.

S13.title: Florida Medicare Supplement oversight
S13.note: OIR is the state oversight/source route. A sample-rate search is not a binding personal quote or evidence that a particular policy is available to a person.

S14.title: Help with drug costs
S14.section: Who gets Extra Help automatically?; applying; wrong amount
S14.note: Assistance affects drug costs. Certain Medicaid/MSP/SSI situations can lead to automatic Extra Help, but notice/current status still matters. Do not request bank records here.

S15.title: Medicare Savings Programs
S15.section: How to qualify; Qualified Medicare Beneficiary
S15.note: States determine MSP eligibility; annual thresholds and state treatment differ. Unknown assistance is not ineligibility; QMB-related cost-sharing protections need correct handling.

S16.title: Special Needs Plans
S16.section: Who can join an SNP?; eligibility requirements
S16.note: SNPs have A/B, service-area and category-specific criteria. Being ill, having Extra Help, or wanting extra benefits does not by itself establish SNP eligibility.

S17.title: Special Enrollment Periods
S17.section: Change where you live; lose coverage; Medicaid/Extra Help; special situations
S17.note: An event can change enrollment opportunities. Allowed changes and dates are event-specific; Medicaid/Extra Help rules must not be reduced to an old quarterly rule.

S18.title: Travel outside the U.S.
S18.note: Routine overseas care, rare Original Medicare exceptions and optional emergency benefits are different. A travel preference does not establish coverage.

S19.title: Advantage provider networks
S19.section: pp. 1–3, provider directories and checking with providers/plan
S19.note: Plan/provider confirmation and exact location matter. A directory identity or Medicare participation is not proof of participation in a particular Advantage contract.

S20.title: RxNorm overview
S20.section: Normalized names: ingredient, strength and dose form
S20.note: Drug identity includes strength and dose form. A normalized identifier alone does not establish a plan formulary match, clinical substitutability or coverage.

S21.title: How drug plans work
S21.note: Specific formulary and pharmacy information is required for coverage/cost checks. General drug coverage is not a promise about a named prescription.

S22.title: Drug plan rules
S22.section: Prior authorization; step therapy; quantity limits
S22.note: Coverage may carry restrictions or require an exception supported by the prescriber. Do not assume approval or transfer an old plan authorization to a new plan.

S23.title: Outpatient prescription drugs
S23.note: Some outpatient drugs can be paid under Part B under particular conditions. A Part-D-only estimator must not silently label such treatment uncovered.

S24.title: Medicare costs
S24.section: Costs for Parts A/B/C/D and Medigap; year-specific tables
S24.note: Plan premium is not total spending. Premiums, care use, deductibles, drug costs and possible income adjustments must be labeled by year and inclusion basis.

S25.title: VA and other insurance
S25.section: VA with Medicare; using each benefit
S25.note: VA and Medicare are distinct care arrangements. VA drug coverage is relevant to Part D coordination; VA coverage is not a blanket reason to delay Part B.

S26.title: Caregiver permission
S26.section: Tip 2: permission to talk to someone trusted
S26.note: Permission to research together is not authorization to retrieve Medicare account information or submit an application. Keep formal authorization outside an ordinary guest research chat.

S27.title: Florida SHINE
S27.note: Official free, unbiased, confidential counseling option. A referral is optional and does not imply an operating Daylight advisor transfer or insurer endorsement.

S28.title: ESRD
S28.note: ESRD changes some coordination facts, including a possible 30-month period. Do not run ordinary age/disability employer-size logic on this case without specialist review.

S29.title: Applying for Extra Help
S29.note: A formal assistance application requires financial information at SSA. This readiness check only records optional program status/interest and sends no application.

triggers.title: One person and requested check
triggers.trigger: A personal comparison is requested and recipient or requested capability is unconfirmed. Reuse a confirmed Ask fact; education-only may bypass.
triggers.question: Who is this coverage for?
triggers.why: Why we ask: We need to keep one person’s details together.
triggers.resolution: Person/context and requested check acknowledged; research may end without personal intake.
triggers.ambiguities: Caregiver describing own drugs mixed with parent’s coverage: separate profiles, never merge people. Do not demand legal authority just to browse.
triggers.evidence_required: User confirmation for research; formal permission required only before protected-account access/application.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unknown subject holds personalized fit; education/samples remain available.
triggers.human_referral: Helper cannot obtain consent or wants official account access: explain authorization and offer SHINE/Medicare.

triggers.title: Residence/service area
triggers.trigger: Requested availability/network check lacks usable home ZIP/county, spans counties, or moving/seasonal facts conflict with home.
triggers.question: Where is your permanent home?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Plan availability depends on where you live.
triggers.resolution: Usable confirmed home scope, or explicit unknown/out-of-area disposition. Do not re-ask an unambiguous confirmed home report solely because it came from Q3.
triggers.ambiguities: Mailing address, winter address and provider location are not automatically permanent residence. Multi-county ZIP needs county confirmation.
triggers.evidence_required: Reported home + accepted ZIP/county lookup; actual plan service-area file for plan/year.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unknown/outside Collier holds local personalized availability; no false unavailable-plan conclusion.
triggers.human_referral: Unsettled residence or interstate move: SHINE/plan service-area review.

triggers.title: Benefit year and intended start
triggers.trigger: Requested benefit year/start is unknown, mismatches source year, or already-on-Medicare answer supplied no comparison year.
triggers.question: Which year should we compare?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Plan benefits and prices can change each year.
triggers.resolution: Explicit year, reusing confirmed Q4 requested month/year where it determines the requested comparison.
triggers.ambiguities: Today’s year, future plan year and current enrollment year are distinct. Unsupported year is not an answer error.
triggers.evidence_required: Accepted source manifest for exactly that year; source-date and effective-year metadata.
triggers.capability_consequence: Mismatched/unsupported year holds current cost/availability claims, not general education.
triggers.human_referral: Urgent effective-date uncertainty: Medicare/SHINE.

triggers.title: Actual A/B enrollment
triggers.trigger: Personal health/drug candidates requested and active/pending Part A/Part B status is not independently represented; Q4 Already on Medicare is insufficient.
triggers.question: Which Medicare parts do you have now?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Different plans require different Medicare parts.
triggers.resolution: Both parts have explicit reported/unknown statuses; pending stays pending.
triggers.ambiguities: An Advantage member still has A/B. Do not call A+B plus Advantage contradictory. Do not infer premium-free A or eligibility from age.
triggers.evidence_required: Reported status is enough for conditional research; official SSA/Medicare record for verified enrollment. Never collect Medicare number/card image here.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unknown A/B holds eligible-to-join claims; MA requires both, standalone D A or B. Browse only with explicit assumptions.
triggers.human_referral: Not enrolled/uncertain: official SSA/Medicare enrollment help.

triggers.title: Actual effective dates
triggers.trigger: Timing/Medigap/change review needs actual A/B dates and they are missing or different from requested start.
triggers.question: When did Part B start?
triggers.why: Why we ask: This can affect your enrollment and Medigap options.

proposed_fields.enrollment.partA.effective: same, asked separately only if needed

triggers.resolution: Relevant dates recorded with precision and provenance, or timing explicitly held.
triggers.ambiguities: One date does not establish both parts. Retroactive A differs from B; requested start is never substituted.
triggers.evidence_required: Self-report/card dates without identifier for research; official record for confirmed timing.
triggers.capability_consequence: Missing dates hold affected timing/GI calculations, not already sourced benefit browsing.
triggers.human_referral: Unexpected/retroactive dates: SSA/SHINE.

triggers.title: Age/eligibility basis
triggers.trigger: Timing, premium eligibility or Medigap rights need age/basis that existing confirmed enrollment does not resolve; not a universal diagnosis screen.
triggers.question: How did you first qualify for Medicare?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Some enrollment rules depend on how you qualified.

proposed_fields.eligibility.birthMonthYear: optional only when timing needs it

triggers.resolution: Relevant basis/age or explicit unknown; ask birthday month/year only if calculation requires it.
triggers.ambiguities: Disability benefits are not always active Medicare. ESRD/ALS timing differs. No full birth date or citizenship documents for ordinary research.
triggers.evidence_required: SSA/Medicare determination for verified eligibility; report alone is provisional.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unknown holds basis-dependent timing/rights/quotes; no automatic ineligibility or age-based recommendation.
triggers.human_referral: Non-age/complex eligibility or citizenship/residency eligibility question: SSA/qualified human, without immigration-detail intake.

triggers.title: Current arrangement vs planned change
triggers.trigger: Current medical arrangement has incompatible same-period reports or user wants to leave MA/Medigap without a clear current-versus-future distinction.
triggers.question: How do you get your A and B benefits now?
triggers.why: Why we ask: We need to separate current coverage from a possible change.
triggers.resolution: Current arrangement and any future change separated; contradictory reports preserved with a resolution link.
triggers.ambiguities: Both Medicare card and MA card can be normal. A reported Medigap policy with MA may be unused/suspended; do not accuse or silently delete it.
triggers.evidence_required: Plan name/ID from safe manual entry if needed, effective date/notice; no membership number.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unresolved arrangement holds safe change-path conclusions and duplicate-coverage assumptions.
triggers.human_referral: Overlapping/pending coverage or cancellation risk: SHINE/plan/benefits administrator.

triggers.title: Enrollment event/window
triggers.trigger: User requests a change/start outside an established reviewed window, or reports move, loss, plan termination, institutional stay, disaster or other potential event.
triggers.question: What changed about your coverage?
triggers.why: Why we ask: This can affect when you can enroll.
triggers.resolution: Applicable event details are available for source-backed review, or window remains unknown.
triggers.ambiguities: Part B, MA/PDP and Medigap windows are separate. A doctor leaving a network is not automatically any generic SEP. Unknown notice date is not fabricated.
triggers.evidence_required: Dated notice/event evidence; reviewed rule version and actual election period; no upload required in MVP.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unknown holds enrollment-action readiness only; scoped browsing may proceed.
triggers.human_referral: Near/past deadline, disaster or exceptional facts: Medicare/SHINE; do not calculate a deadline from guesswork.

triggers.title: Current employment vs continuation
triggers.trigger: Q5 employer/retiree/COBRA or free text indicates job-related insurance, but source of coverage/current-work relationship unclear.
triggers.question: Is this coverage from someone who is still working?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Current work can affect your Medicare sign-up window.
triggers.resolution: Coverage kind/current work clarified or explicitly unresolved.
triggers.ambiguities: An employer name does not mean active-employment coverage; a stipend/individual policy may differ. Multiple jobs/plans remain separate.
triggers.evidence_required: Benefits administrator confirmation of group/current-work status.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unknown holds delay/payer-order advice; not a reason to suppress noncommercial plan options.
triggers.human_referral: Self-employed/individual reimbursement/multiple plans: benefits administrator/BCRC/SHINE.

triggers.title: Relevant employer size
triggers.trigger: Current group coverage plus payer-order question; age/basis known. Do not run age threshold for ESRD.
triggers.question: Does the employer have 20 or more employees?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Employer size can change which coverage pays first.
triggers.resolution: Age-65 case uses 20 threshold; under-65 disability variant asks “100 or more employees?”; uncertain multi-employer facts remain held.
triggers.ambiguities: Do not use 20 universally; do not apply either shortcut to ESRD. Family-member coverage under disability needs exact review.
triggers.evidence_required: Employer/benefits administrator size and group classification, not an LLM/company-web headcount guess.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unresolved holds payer-order/delay conclusions; plan benefit comparison still possible with warnings.
triggers.human_referral: Multi-employer or ESRD: BCRC/SHINE; no automatic payer verdict.

triggers.title: Separate loss/job dates
triggers.trigger: Coverage/job ending or ended, COBRA/retiree transition, or prospective change needs loss chronology.
triggers.question: When did the job end?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Different end dates can change your sign-up window.
answers: Date selector with unknown parts allowed
triggers.resolution: Ask approved child “When does the job-based health coverage end?” only if missing; save dates independently.
triggers.ambiguities: Do not substitute retirement, COBRA expiry, notice date or requested start for active group coverage loss. Ranges crossing a deadline stay uncertain.
triggers.evidence_required: Employer/coverage notices or user’s dated report; actual documents only through an approved future secure path.
triggers.capability_consequence: Missing dates hold transition/deadline advice; explain which exact check remains open.
triggers.human_referral: Potential gap/late enrollment: prompt official enrollment review, not automated cancellation.

triggers.title: Creditable drug coverage/gap
triggers.trigger: Part D is absent/ending/unknown and employer/retiree/military/other drug coverage might exist, or user proposes no drug coverage.
triggers.question: Does your plan say its drug coverage is creditable?
triggers.why: Why we ask: A gap in qualifying drug coverage can affect later costs.
triggers.resolution: Notice status and relevant end date recorded or unresolved; no penalty amount invented.
triggers.ambiguities: No current prescriptions does not mean no need to consider D. The 63-day issue is not an MA/PDP election deadline or the eight-month Part B clock.
triggers.evidence_required: Current written creditable-coverage notice and coverage dates; assistance status can change penalty analysis.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unknown holds penalty/transition conclusions; no blanket no-D recommendation.
triggers.human_referral: Missing notice, gap, family-retiree risk: benefits administrator/Medicare/SHINE.

triggers.title: Retiree/family benefit consequences
triggers.trigger: Employer/union/retiree coverage exists and user considers joining outside MA/PDP or dropping group coverage.
triggers.question: Could a change affect anyone else’s coverage?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Some changes can affect family or retiree benefits.
triggers.resolution: Administrator report recorded; unchecked remains a specific action item.
triggers.ambiguities: Joining an outside plan can have consequences beyond the beneficiary. Do not assume coverage can be restored.
triggers.evidence_required: Benefits administrator’s plan-specific confirmation, ideally retained notice.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unconfirmed holds recommended change/action; general comparison can remain available.
triggers.human_referral: Benefits administrator before any enrollment/cancellation; human help optional.

triggers.title: HSA timing
triggers.trigger: User reports current-work coverage, Medicare deferral/retroactive A or specifically mentions HSA contributions.
triggers.question: Are you or your employer adding money to an HSA?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Medicare start dates can affect HSA contributions.
triggers.resolution: No ends the trigger; yes/unknown creates review task, never an automated tax instruction.
triggers.ambiguities: An HSA balance differs from current contributions. Do not request balance/account number or equate retirement date with Part A effective date.
triggers.evidence_required: Actual Part A/benefit application dates and tax/benefits advice, not just a requested start month.
triggers.capability_consequence: Holds HSA/tax timing advice; not all plan comparisons.
triggers.human_referral: Benefits/tax professional and SSA for retroactive-date implications.

triggers.title: Florida Medigap purchase window
triggers.trigger: Original+Medigap purchase/replacement path requested; age, basis, Part B start or qualifying group-loss dates are missing or not reviewed.
triggers.question: When did your Part B coverage begin?
triggers.why: Why we ask: This can affect your Medigap purchase rights.

proposed_fields.medigap.partBStart: reference enrollment date, no duplicate fact

triggers.resolution: Reuse dates already confirmed; evaluate federal and Florida candidates separately. Resolution is facts sufficient for expert review, not guaranteed issue confirmed.
triggers.ambiguities: Florida six-month and qualifying group-termination two-month provisions differ from federal event-specific rights. Do not promise every policy/price or apply Florida elsewhere.
triggers.evidence_required: Florida residency, age/basis, B dates and relevant termination evidence; approved jurisdiction/year rule receipt.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unreviewed rights hold issueability/underwriting-free/quote eligibility claims; public Medigap benefit explanations remain possible.
triggers.human_referral: Licensed Florida expert/SHINE/OIR when window/rights uncertain.

triggers.title: Trial/guaranteed-issue history
triggers.trigger: Current/recent MA plus interest in Original+Medigap, lost supplement, plan termination/move or alleged insurer misconduct.
triggers.question: Was this your first Medicare Advantage plan?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Your coverage history may affect Medigap rights.
triggers.resolution: Only missing approved child questions asked: “When did it start?” and “Did you have Medigap before it?” Events reach specialist review.
triggers.ambiguities: First MA at initial Medicare eligibility and dropping Medigap to try MA are distinct trial patterns; plan letters/availability differ. Never convert within-12-month report alone to guaranteed rights.
triggers.evidence_required: Prior policy/join/end dates, reason for loss and dated notices; rule-specific source and expert receipt.
triggers.capability_consequence: Holds guaranteed-issue/transition confidence; does not hide Original/MA alternatives.
triggers.human_referral: Licensed Florida reviewer/SHINE before relinquishing current coverage.

triggers.title: Existing Medigap replacement
triggers.trigger: User already has Medigap and wants another supplement/carrier or is considering dropping it.
triggers.question: Are you replacing an existing Medigap policy?
triggers.why: Why we ask: You may not have the same rights to buy it again.
triggers.resolution: Keep means no replacement intake; replace/unknown retains current coverage and review task.
triggers.ambiguities: Annual MA/PDP open enrollment is not universal Medigap open enrollment. Do not demand diagnosis/underwriting history in this readiness chat.
triggers.evidence_required: Current policy letter, issue history and new insurer’s actual acceptance/rate; final replacement rules separate.
triggers.capability_consequence: Holds accepted/purchasable replacement claim and cancellation steps, not standardized-benefit browsing.
triggers.human_referral: Licensed reviewer/insurer before cancellation; explain review is optional, not a sales gate.

triggers.title: Assistance status without financial intake
triggers.trigger: Subsidy-adjusted costs, a reported Medicaid program, affordability concern or explicit help request makes program status consequential.
triggers.question: Do you get help with Medicare costs now?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Assistance can change what you pay.
triggers.resolution: Current program reports/unknown/declined recorded; offer official application support, not a local eligibility decision.
triggers.ambiguities: Medicaid, QMB/MSP, Extra Help and SSI are distinct. Program amount/year can change; no bank, tax-return or account collection here.
triggers.evidence_required: Current benefit/decision notice or official program check with separate permission; state/SSA determines eligibility.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unknown holds personalized subsidy-adjusted costs/SNP eligibility, not unsubsidized labeled scenarios.
triggers.human_referral: SHINE/state Medicaid/SSA; finances submitted directly through approved official process.

triggers.title: SNP-specific qualification
triggers.scope: MVP flags/referral; detailed SNP matching future
triggers.trigger: User asks about an SNP or volunteers Medicaid/qualifying institutional/chronic circumstances and a supported candidate actually requires them.
triggers.question: Has anyone confirmed you qualify for this type of special-needs plan?
triggers.why: Why we ask: These plans have additional enrollment requirements.
answers: I do not want to explore these plans
triggers.resolution: Category and evidence routed to plan/state review; decline closes this optional exploration without erasing known assistance.
triggers.ambiguities: Extra Help alone is not full Medicaid or proof of D-SNP alignment; a diagnosis mention is not verified C-SNP eligibility. No exhaustive diagnosis questionnaire.
triggers.evidence_required: Applicable state/plan eligibility proof, A/B, area and alignment requirements for exact plan/year.
triggers.capability_consequence: Only SNP eligibility/fit held; other available paths not suppressed.
triggers.human_referral: Plan/state/qualified reviewer for exact criteria.

triggers.title: Seasonal/routine travel
triggers.trigger: Q8 another-state/outside-US/unknown or moving/seasonal facts make care locations material to requested provider/travel fit.
triggers.question: Where will you need routine care away from home?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Routine care and emergency care can have different coverage.
triggers.resolution: Routine/emergency need and locations clarified or travel-fit limitation retained.
triggers.ambiguities: Seasonal stay does not automatically change permanent home. A PPO label or foreign emergency benefit does not promise routine access.
triggers.evidence_required: Plan EOC/network/travel-benefit terms for year; provider/location checks.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unknown holds travel-fit claims only; no automated Original-over-Advantage preference.
triggers.human_referral: Complex residency/long overseas stay: plan/SHINE; travel insurance referral only if requested.

triggers.title: Exact provider identity/location
triggers.trigger: Provider-fit requested and Q6 names are unresolved, ambiguous, location-free, or source/network result unavailable.
triggers.question: Which location do you use for this doctor?
triggers.why: Why we ask: The office location can affect the network check.
triggers.resolution: User confirms the exact provider/location; identity resolution remains separate from network verification.
triggers.ambiguities: Do not choose among duplicate names by LLM confidence. Hospital/facility and doctor may need distinct checks; Medicare acceptance is not MA participation.
triggers.evidence_required: Accepted directory plus exact plan contract/year and dated plan/provider confirmation; public provider ID alone insufficient.
triggers.capability_consequence: Missing identity holds fit for that provider. Missing network source is a system limitation, not a negative score or another user question.
triggers.human_referral: Conflicting directories/ongoing treatment: plan/provider and optional human.

triggers.title: Exact prescription identity
triggers.trigger: Drug-fit/cost requested and medication string lacks a unique ingredient/brand, strength or form; preserve original wording.
triggers.question: Which version of this prescription do you take?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Strength and form can change the coverage check.
triggers.resolution: Confirmed identity tuple or explicit unresolved entity; one prompt per grouped missing tuple, not every field as another page.
triggers.ambiguities: Similar names, extended-release vs immediate-release, salt/route and brand alternatives must not be silently substituted. Do not recommend medication changes.
triggers.evidence_required: User confirmation plus accepted terminology mapping and plan formulary identity/version; exact match requires live validated data.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unknown holds that drug’s coverage/price, not an inferred uncovered verdict or all general plan information.
triggers.human_referral: Bottle/prescriber/pharmacist clarification; no image upload or medical advice required.

triggers.title: Supply and pharmacy
triggers.trigger: A drug-cost check is requested and days supply/quantity/fill channel or exact pharmacy is missing.
triggers.question: How do you usually fill this prescription?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Supply and pharmacy can change the price.
triggers.resolution: Required pricing inputs complete or the cost dimension explicitly withheld.
triggers.ambiguities: Dose instructions and dispensed quantity differ. Preferred vs standard network, specialty channels and travel pharmacies need evidence, not guesses.
triggers.evidence_required: Accepted plan pharmacy-network/pricing files for plan/year/fill tuple; user preference does not prove participation.
triggers.capability_consequence: Missing inputs hold personal drug estimate only; a flat copay or premium must not stand in for total cost.
triggers.human_referral: Pharmacist/plan when fill pattern or specialty pharmacy unclear.

triggers.title: Restrictions and Part B/D boundary
triggers.trigger: Validated source flags PA/ST/quantity restrictions, administration setting is ambiguous, or user reports a current exception/coverage problem.
triggers.question: Is this given at a clinic or filled at a pharmacy?
triggers.why: Why we ask: Some medicines use different Medicare coverage rules.
triggers.resolution: Setting/reported problem preserved; restriction approval remains separate pending plan/prescriber confirmation.
triggers.ambiguities: An old authorization does not establish approval under a new plan. Do not ask users to diagnose which Medicare part pays or waive requirements.
triggers.evidence_required: Plan formulary/EOC, indication/setting where officially necessary, and prescriber/plan decision; minimum health context only with consent.
triggers.capability_consequence: Restricted coverage displayed as conditional; unsupported Part-B drug costing withheld instead of marked not covered.
triggers.human_referral: Prescriber/pharmacist/plan for approvals, exceptions or continuity issues.

triggers.title: Affordability vs preference
triggers.trigger: Cost priority or numeric budget request is material; Q9 cost preference alone does not establish affordability or total annual spending.
triggers.question: Is there a monthly amount you want to stay under?
triggers.why: Why we ask: A low plan premium is not the whole cost.
triggers.resolution: Budget basis acknowledged or unknown; do not force financial disclosure.
triggers.ambiguities: Include/exclude Part B, Medigap, drug/medical use and possible income adjustments explicitly. No income/tax documents here; unknown medical use prevents a guaranteed total.
triggers.evidence_required: Year-specific accepted premium/benefit/drug/rate sources plus clearly dated assumptions; estimated vs binding quote separated.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unknown budget limits affordability assessment only; absent source/care-use assumptions holds personalized total/ranking, not all browsing.
triggers.human_referral: SHINE for cost assistance; SSA for income-adjustment questions; clinician never inferred by spending.

triggers.title: Military/veterans coordination
triggers.trigger: Q5 military category or free text indicates VA, TRICARE, CHAMPVA or another federal program without exact program context.
triggers.question: Which military or veterans’ coverage do you have?
triggers.why: Why we ask: These programs work with Medicare in different ways.
triggers.resolution: Program classified for correct official referral; unresolved stays unknown.
triggers.ambiguities: VA is not TRICARE. Do not universally advise joining/dropping D, dropping B or adding Medigap; family consequences may matter.
triggers.evidence_required: Relevant program/plan eligibility and coordination guidance; no service/membership identifiers.
triggers.capability_consequence: Unresolved holds coordination and recommended change conclusions, not neutral education.
triggers.human_referral: VA/TRICARE/program administrator/BCRC/SHINE for exact arrangement.

triggers.title: Material exception/continuity
triggers.trigger: User/notice reports ESRD coordination, institutional stay, disaster, plan misconduct/termination, imminent coverage/refill gap or another source-listed exception. Do not screen everyone for every condition.
triggers.question: Is there a coverage interruption you need help with now?
triggers.why: Why we ask: An immediate gap may need a different next step.
triggers.resolution: Route only to approved event child or unresolved human review; no new LLM-generated insurance branch.
triggers.ambiguities: Never translate serious illness to SNP eligibility, presume ESRD prevents MA enrollment, or infer an exception from vague urgency. No clinical triage/medical recommendation.
triggers.evidence_required: Event-specific official source/notice; reviewed exception adapter. Rare unsupported events end in a documented human/source check.
triggers.capability_consequence: Holds only affected timing/coordination/continuity assurances; no false safety guarantee.
triggers.human_referral: Medicare/SHINE and relevant plan/provider; no automatic external message.

triggers.title: Conflicting or ambiguous proposed facts
triggers.trigger: Same person/period has mutually exclusive confirmed reports, unconfirmed text interpretation, or a result conflicts with the profile.
triggers.question: Which detail should we use?
triggers.why: Why we ask: These answers lead to different checks.
answers: They apply at different times + dates
triggers.resolution: One explicit resolution or defer; one clarification retry maximum, then held. Facts at different times may both remain valid.
triggers.ambiguities: A+B membership and MA are not intrinsically inconsistent. Do not silently pick newer-looking text or AI confidence; preserve history and prior confirmed answers.
triggers.evidence_required: User confirmation for report resolution; independent evidence still separately required for coverage truth.
triggers.capability_consequence: Only dependent capabilities held; no favorable default/ranking.
triggers.human_referral: Unresolvable conflict or official notice disagreement: qualified human with user-controlled summary.

triggers.title: Source/data capability guard

triggers.question: No question: show the specific unavailable check.
triggers.why: Why we ask: Your answers cannot replace a missing source check.

proposed_fields.sources.receipt: manifest/code/rule digest + approved review; null remains held
